library.blurb_zh: 清早，大石头滚开了，天使说：“他不在这里，他复活了！”马利亚在花园里听见耶稣叫她的名字，彼得和约翰赛跑去看空坟墓——耶稣活着，他说到做到！
library.blurb_en: Early in the morning the big stone is rolled away and an angel says: “He is not here, He is risen!” Mary hears Jesus say her name in the garden, Peter and John race to the empty tomb: Jesus is alive, and He keeps His promises!

fx.note: He Is Risen! (StoryFxRisen.cs: tomb_glow, butterflies; CONTRACT §8)
